parsed.reason: The Arabic text states every given fact correctly (closed after the earlier no, cannot be reopened, saying yes now changes nothing, still open to other introductions, Hale will text when it finds a good match) and adds no invented promises, apologies, or details. It uses the plural/formal كم, which avoids assuming gender, and reads as a person texting. Minor issue: قبل قليل (a little while ago) adds a time detail the facts only call 'earlier', and للأسف is a mild unrequested apology-like softener, and the register is slightly formal.
